headline: Ledger reviews policies after supply-chain hardware implant drains crypto wallets
summary: Ledger hardware wallets sold through a third-party reseller were fitted with hidden implants that captured recovery phrases and drained funds. Ledger asked the reseller to pause sales during its investigation and is reviewing its chain-of-custody and anti-tamper policies. Tom's Hardware reported the estimated stolen total grew from $71 million to $93 million as coverage continued.
